INFORMATION CONTAINED IN THIS REPORT ON FORM 6-K

 

As previously disclosed, on April 7, 2026, DarkIris Inc. (the “Company”) entered into certain share purchase agreements with 11 investors (the “Private Placement”). The Company also entered into a short video drama purchase agreement with a company incorporated in Hong Kong to purchase certain short video dramas content (the “Short Video Drama Purchase Agreement”).

 

The Private Placement closed on April 24, 2026, and the Company received a net proceeds of approximately $3.8 million. The Company intends to use the net proceeds to fund its development of its Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content platform and other general corporate purposes.

 

The transaction contemplated by the Short Video Drama Purchase Agreement also closed on April 24, 2026, under which the Company acquired a portfolio of 10 film and television intellectual property titles.

 

On April 24, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the closing of the Private Placement and the completion of the Short Video Drama Purchase Agreement. The full text of the Press Release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 6-K.
